name: SubArabify
description: Automatic Arabic subtitles via a Colab T4 backend. Unified companion for the Android app - scans a library, routes each movie (skip / translate / transcribe), and writes branded MovieName.SubArabify.ar.srt. Configure one backend URL; show it as a QR code on the TV for the phone app.

artifacts.changelog: 0.2.3-alpha: unified backend-driven addon - one colab_url everywhere, QR on TV, Termux runner, LAN config endpoint.
